relations: Dante 是吸血鬼国王，十二年前（twelve years earlier）被想夺其王位的人关进 Shadowside Penitentiary；吸血鬼是这座城市的四类恶魔之一。
Ophelia 名下有内阁（Cabinet）的一个席位，但她每次都把邀请函扔掉；实权在形同黑手党的 fae royals 手里。
监狱以帮派分治：蓝光环男子拦人时称 Shiv's gang gets this one if they want her，Shiv 是其中一位帮派头目。
Ophelia 潜入监狱的目标是救出两名 demon royals，Dante 是她要找的人之一。

facts.fact: Ophelia 乘电梯下行，落到地下九层（nine floors）抵达 Shadowside Penitentiary。
facts.anchor: There was a sad-sounding ding as it stopped, nine floors under the sprawling magical city I lived in.

facts.fact: Ophelia 走进主区，所有没在打斗的 immortal 囚犯都转头盯着她。
facts.anchor: Because every one of the immortals who weren't in the middle of a fight, were looking at me.

facts.fact: Ophelia 认出彩光环男子是 Dante——十二年前被人夺位囚禁的吸血鬼国王。
facts.anchor: His name was Dante, and he was the vampire king who had been imprisoned by people who wanted to take his throne twelve years earlier.

facts.fact: 蓝光环男子拦下绿光环者，宣称这个女人归 Shiv's gang。
facts.anchor: You took the last woman. Shiv's gang gets this one if they want her.

facts.fact: 绿光环者喝令证明 pixie 身份，Ophelia 从指尖弹出火花自证。
facts.anchor: It was relatively effortless to make sparks appear from my fingers.

facts.fact: 她自称 pixie 后三人齐扑，Dante 最快把她扑倒咬进颈静脉。
facts.anchor: Dante reached me first, taking me to the ground, and a set of fangs sank into my jugular.

facts.fact: 警报响起，Ophelia 自己的黑暗魔法气息涌入空气。
facts.anchor: Vaguely, I heard an alarm blaring around us, and the intense feeling of my own dark magic flooded the air.

facts.fact: Ophelia 抓住 Dante 双肩、双腿缠腰不让他逃。
facts.anchor: I grabbed Dante's shoulders, wrapping my legs around his waist so he couldn't get away from me.
